notes: One Canon service manual (2006) covers the MP600 and MP600R; the part numbers are Canon service-part numbers from its error and service parts tables. The Bluetooth unit is an optional extra, so it is only there on machines that were fitted with it.

gaps: The manual says it does not give enough information for disassembly and points to a separate Parts Catalog, which is not in this copy. Part numbers are therefore only the ones printed in the error table and the service parts table.
The carriage and paper feed motors have Canon part numbers, but no type, voltage or resistance is given for either.

The troubleshooting names a power supply unit and tells the reader to replace the AC adapter; the standards list says 'Machine, Adapter'. Only the machine's AC input range is stated, so no v or w value is set.
The logic board ass'y (QM3-0250) is named in many error remedies, but its chips are not, so no chip is claimed.
The manual gives no part number for the CIS itself; QM2-3940 is the scanner unit's number and the scanner specification gives the sensor type as CIS.
No production years are stated. The manual's copyright year is 2006.
method: Canon PIXMA MP600 / MP600R Service Manual (Canon U.S.A., copyright 2006), 71-page PDF from Internet Archive item manualzilla-id-7351412. A user upload, not Canon's own host; the cover names both models and page headers say PIXMA MP600. The copy prints no document number.

Sections used: 1-1 and 1-2 (maintenance), 1-2-2 (service call errors), 1-2-5 (troubleshooting), 1-3-1 (service parts table), 1-3-3 (grease table), 3-3 (specifications). Part numbers wrapped across lines in the error table were checked on the rendered page.
The Internet Archive item page was read for the upload details.

comps.spec: Carriage motor, Canon part QK1-1500, listed among the parts to replace for the carriage error (service call, 2 blinks, code 5100)
Paper feed motor, Canon part QK1-1502 (service parts table and line feed error code 6000); its red screws may be loosened only when the motor unit is replaced
Paper feed motor belt; when the motor is replaced it is positioned so that the belt is stretched tight (adjustment table)
Timing slit strip film, Canon QC1-6526 (service parts table and carriage error code 5100); wipe with ethanol if touched, keep grease off
Timing slit disk film, Canon QC2-0475 (service parts table and line feed error code 6000); keep grease off, wipe with ethanol and do not bend it
Timing slit disk eject film, Canon QC2-0476 (service parts table); keep grease off and wipe any grease off with ethanol
Timing sensor unit, Canon QM3-1271, listed among the parts to replace for the line feed error (code 6000)
Scanner unit, Canon QM2-3940 (listed for the scanner home position error, code 5010); the scanner specification gives the sensor type as CIS (contact image sensor)
Platen glass of the flatbed scanner, cleaned in the scanning area cleaning and named in the document pressure sheet position adjustment
Carriage shaft: the red screws at both ends must not be loosened; the grease table lists Floil KG107A for the shaft
Carriage shaft spring L, named in the grease table and greased with Floil KG107A
PR lift shaft assembly, Canon QL2-1450 (service parts table); listed for the carriage lift error (code 5110) and greased when replaced
Input carriage lift gear, Canon QC2-1873 (service parts table); greased when replaced
AC adapter / power supply unit, named in the no-power troubleshooting (replace the AC adapter); the machine specification gives AC 100 to 240 V, 50/60 Hz
Optional Bluetooth 1.2 unit that attaches to the machine: supply voltage 4.4 to 5.25 V, power consumption 500 mW maximum, 2.4 GHz band
